official_title: NMR Based Metabolomic Study of Serum Biomarkers in Patients With Parkinson's Disease and Atypical Parkinsonian Syndrome
summary: At present, the diagnosis of Parkinsons disease(PD) mainly relies on clinical symptoms and is easily confused with atypical Parkinsonian syndrome(APS) in the early stages. There is an urgent need for reliable biomarkers. This project aims to use metabolomics technology based on proton nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy to study the metabolomic characteristics of patients with PD and APS, and preliminarily screen for possible diagnostic biomarkers of PD and APS.
title: NMR Based Metabolomic Study of Serum Biomarkers in Patients With Parkinson's Disease and Atypical Parkinsonian Syndrome
